name: Universal Beta Splatting (UBS)
aliases: Universal Beta Splatting (UBS) / N-dimensional Beta Kernel
definition: An N-dimensional kernel that uses a gated product form to enable per-dimension shape control, addressing the dimensional coupling limitations of Gaussian kernels where all dimensions are coupled through a joint Gaussian distribution.
summary: Universal Beta Splatting replaces Gaussian kernels with a Beta function to enable independent per-dimension shape control, addressing the dimensional coupling limitations of methods like 6DGS.
